attestations.text: CHANG Yü-shu 張玉書 (T. 素存, H. 潤甫), July 22, 1642–1711, July 2, official and scholar, was a native of Tan-t'u, Kiangsu, second son of Chang Chiu-chêng 張九徵 (T. 公選, H. 湘曉, 1618–1684, chin-shih of 1647 and director of education of Honan in 1664–67).
張玉書，字素存，江南丹徒人。

westernYears.note: Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.
Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.

accounts.evidence: 張玉書，字素存，江南丹徒人。父九徵，字湘曉。順治二年，舉鄉試第一。九年，成進士。博學礪行，精春秋三傳，尤邃於史。歷吏部文選郎中。出為河南提學僉事，考績最，當超擢，遽引疾歸。
